end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects that roll, slide, or stack. Anika explained that a box can slide and that objects such as a drum, orange, and tin can roll when placed on a curved side; they also described how some objects can roll one way and stand or stack another way. Anika mixed up the idea by saying only balls roll, and this was not corrected after the final time it appeared. At home, try rolling a bottle, tin, or orange in different positions and ask which surface touches the floor.
